links.outcome: LLM performance across temperature settings (default vs zero) on five clinical decision tasks
links.effect: ChatGPT performed better under zero temperature, whereas Llama showed stronger performance under default temperature; performance varied by model and setting.
links.quote: Furthermore, ChatGPT performed better under the zero temperature, whereas LIama showed stronger performance under the default temperature.

links.outcome: LLM performance on real-world clinical decision tasks versus knowledge assessments
links.effect: Near-perfect accuracy in final diagnosis, poor performance in relevant diagnostic testing, and moderate performance in remaining tasks across three LLMs.
